title: Near-Optimal Acceleration for Smooth $\ell_p$ / $\ell_q$ Nondual Convex First-Order Oracle Optimization
summary: We study the optimization of convex objectives with $(L,κ-1)$-Hölder-continuous gradients in $\ell_q$ over $R B_p^d$, $1<κ\le 2$. (MG26) provides selectors with a movement bound for the problem of chasing high-dimensional convex nested sets for every $p<q$ and generally reduces Lipschitz convex optimization to bounds on the movement of selectors.
